title: Daily AI Newsletter Weekly Recap — October 18, 2026
summary: This week, AI safety oversight compressed from self-reported incident disclosures into a formal FTC investigation of OpenAI and Anthropic in six days; liability for 'ship first, fix later' decisions landed on Meta and OpenAI alike; Meta's frontier breakout set off a pricing war across Google, Microsoft, and DeepSeek; and Anthropic headed into its November IPO with a Japan data center, slowing growth, and a self-disclosed conflict of interest in its own financing.
